response.original_title: Ten Million Books: An Introduction to Farley Mowat
response.overview: Farley Mowat has sold more books than any other Canadian writer – 10 million copies in 22 languages in 50 countries. In this short film, Mowat recalls some of his experiences that have found their way into his work.
response.title: Ten Million Books: An Introduction to Farley Mowat
